verbatim: Studio eyes needs to see what’s there and notice how content doesn’t optimally meet its objective within founder asks
subject: Builds measured against founder asks
principle: The studio checks builds against what the founder asked for, not against its own reading of the page.

verbatim: This is a harvest op don’t accept as bible
subject: Harvested chat text is evidence, not law
principle: A chat harvest surfaces founder words; it does not ratify them. Later founder words supersede earlier ones.

verbatim: So you need to be more truthful to the founder.
subject: No claims the founder did not make
principle: Studio-facing copy must not claim positions (an 'edge') the founder never claimed.

verbatim: Show opportunities, but those are fact based, not sales pitches.
subject: Opportunities as mapped facts, not pitches
principle: Scale-up and market possibilities are shown as tagged mappings (K-12, industry), never as sales copy.
note: Not machine-checkable yet: needs a tone rubric. Human read.

verbatim: each game must go through a rigorous staging area where studio eyes and agentic playtesters inform the recursive design process.
subject: Staging with eyes and agent playtesters
principle: Every game passes a staging area where Studio Eyes and agent playtesters feed the next iteration.

verbatim: But funny failure. is a requirement.
subject: Funny failure in Sandbags
principle: Failure is funny, never shameful: a crash plays a gag in the village.

verbatim: None of them look like art like paintings. And they really should look like paintings.
subject: Sandbags scenes read as paintings
principle: Scene art is judged by composition, as a painting is; clip-art layouts fail.
note: Composition is a Studio Eyes judgment; no arithmetic check exists. Human read.

verbatim: Must have >50% images
subject: Image-first screens
principle: Game screens are more than half image.
note: No pixel-share gate exists for this. Candidate tooth for studio-eyes-pixel.py.

verbatim: The comfort button needs to be ONE button that toggles, not 5 buttons etc.
subject: Comfort control is one toggle
principle: Comfort is a single live control, not a panel of buttons.

verbatim: where the O lets you toggle 5 different high value states
subject: Comfort control shape: - O +
principle: Minus is smaller type, plus is larger, O cycles five states.
note: Shape is a visual ruling; check by Studio Eyes on each build.

verbatim: Sometimes some of these 5 states will differ NOT just for comfort but for terministic screens and epistemic frames to bend to player
subject: Comfort states can carry frames
principle: The five states may switch terministic screens / epistemic frames, not only comfort.

verbatim: Epistemic frames and terministic screens as skins is important to demonstrate.
subject: Frames as switchable skins
principle: Show a system under several metaphors (river, wiring diagram) at one tap.

verbatim: epistemic frames doesnt meen re-narrating the story, but the voice changes.
subject: A frame changes voice, not story
principle: Switching frame keeps the content and symmetry; only the voice and metaphor change.

verbatim: I wanna change it from Roke to dress rehearsal.
subject: Row K renamed Dress Rehearsal
principle: Player-facing name is Dress Rehearsal.

verbatim: Allow people to paste their own text to play.
subject: Sandbags: play your own text
principle: A player can paste their own story into Sandbags.

verbatim: sandbags needs an opening that demonstrates the principle of lightness by showing a cluttered page get lighter.
subject: Sandbags opens on lightness
principle: The opening shows a cluttered page getting lighter before play.

verbatim: 3 strikes
subject: Sandbags: strikes before a crash
principle: Cutting a key word wobbles the balloon; a crash only after strikes.

verbatim: Use my own writing as samples instead of made up.
subject: Founder writing as game text
principle: Sample texts come from the founder's own writing, marked as founder-verbatim.
note: Checks the provenance marker convention from the voice manifest D5. A game may carry founder text without the marker; then the marker is what is missing.

verbatim: At the end of Kireji pond show the poems like refrigerator magnets on a 1950s refrigerator made in ukiyo r style.
subject: Kireji: the 1950s ukiyo-e fridge
principle: Poems end up as magnets on a 1950s fridge cut in woodblock style; lines movable, pencil to write, export by email.

verbatim: Add a pencil that allows the user to edit the haiku and the new text
subject: Kireji: pencil edit
principle: The player can edit the haiku and see the edit on the fridge.

verbatim: add a new mode called cliche creek
subject: Kireji: Cliché Creek mode
principle: A mode where real haiku are rescued from a stream of clichés.

verbatim: Choose 5 haiku and gameplay moves through sequence
subject: Cliché Creek: five haiku in sequence
principle: The creek plays five chosen haiku in order.

verbatim: the sound button is hogging prime play space. Make it an icon only and smaller.
subject: Kireji: sound is a small icon
principle: Sound control yields play space.

verbatim: Hedge wins.
subject: Kireji: hedged win copy
principle: Win copy asks (does this poem land with you?) rather than declaring.

verbatim: I still see it spit back to me as as a media literacy game, and that's incorrect.
subject: CYL is not a media-literacy game
principle: Choose Your Leader is about what drives our choices of leaders; it is not pitched as media literacy.

verbatim: I need psychologists and historians looking at what really drives our choices and attitudes
subject: CYL grounded in psychology and history
principle: CYL's frame is what drives choices and attitudes, with psychologists and historians on the panel.
note: Panel composition lives in convenings; human read.

verbatim: Public domain for CYL. I want photorealistic with magazine collage but crafted  like Lumino
subject: CYL art: public-domain photo collage
principle: Public-domain photography, magazine-collage treatment, Lumino craft.

verbatim: I want TSP game designs (staging and visible where instructive) to utilize the world of goo physics.
subject: World of Goo physics for knowledge kernels
principle: Where a knowledge kernel is shown as structure, it uses World of Goo-style physics that make a broken system visible.

verbatim: Knowledge kernels don’t always need to be expressed in physics and illustrate. When it does, use goo
subject: Goo only where physics illustrates
principle: Physics is optional; when used, it is goo physics.

verbatim: All games labeled currently in honest state. Intent. Status. Possibility space. Roadblocks.
subject: Every game labeled with honest state
principle: The game shelf shows each game's intent, status, possibility space and roadblocks.

verbatim: need clear back buttons and home buttons
subject: Clear Back and Home on every game
principle: Every arcade game has a visible way back to the arcade and home.

verbatim: memory says papercut optimal but that pigeonholes; use mnemonic situated design leveraging learning sciences and visual rhetoric and grammar for efficacy.
subject: Art style follows the learning job
principle: Cut-paper is not a house default; mnemonic, situated design chosen for the learning task.
note: Supersedes the 2026-06-22 cut-paper lock in spirit; human read.

verbatim: Give provenance the full TSP treatment
subject: Provenance game
principle: The syllabus AI policy becomes a game that shows students get provenance.
note: No build file named yet; a word search for 'provenance' would pass on unrelated pages, so this stays a human read until a file exists.

verbatim: Make studio eyes the best version of what I want it to be.
subject: Studio Eyes as a working critic
principle: Studio Eyes interprets what is on screen (visual rhetoric, legibility) and directs the founder on real pages.

verbatim: Spirals are supposed to be spiraling.
subject: Knowledge kernels and year-long staff training
principle: Seed games are built from knowledge kernels; panelists train across studio, Lumiere, MassBay.
